body:
Robert A. Stanger & Co., a firm in non-listed alternative investment products, has published its third quarter 2026 non-listed business development company (BDC) edition of The Stanger Report. The issue highlights widening net outflows as fundraising continued to decline, even as redemption demand moderated and performance strengthened.

Publicly registered nonlisted BDCs raised $1.5 billion in third quarter 2026, down 87 percent from third quarter 2025. It was the lowest quarterly total since fourth quarter 2020, before Blackstone Private Credit Fund and Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. began raising capital, falling below the previous low set in second quarter 2026. Through September, year-to-date fundraising totaled $8.6 billion, down 76 percent from $35.1 billion in the first nine months of 2025.

공모 비상장 BDC들은 2026년 3분기에 15억 달러의 자금을 조달해 2025년 3분기 대비 87% 급감했다. 이는 Blackstone Private Credit Fund와 Blue Owl Credit Income Corp.가 펀드레이징을 시작하기 전인 2020년 4분기 이후 가장 낮은 분기 실적이며, 2026년 2분기에 기록한 이전 최저치마저 밑돌았다. 9월까지의 연초 이후 누적 펀드레이징 규모는 86억 달러로, 2025년 동기 351억 달러 대비 76% 감소했다.
